<$voicel(1,5)>You’ve shown me so many <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3997)>...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Just seeing them warmed this old heart. They brought back

<$voicel(1,5)>You’ve shown me so many <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3998)>...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Just seeing them warmed this old heart. They brought back
memories of when humans were here!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>But, you know...from the small things to the large ones...
<$voicel(1,7)>Humans sure left an awful lot of stuff behind!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>So until they return, I think we should take good care of
these things and put them to good use!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>You know, I just recalled—<$cdef(27)>
was
hoping
to
talk
to you.

<$voicel(1,3)>Why don’t you go see what <$cdef(27)>
has
to say?

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Have the Pokémon been requesting help from you at all?
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,824)>If a Pokémon asked you for help and you’ve forgotten
the details, try talking to them again. <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>That might help you
remember, yes?<$motion(1,652)>

You can also check your Pokémon requests by selecting
<$cdef(27)>Requests on the main menu!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Have you run out of things to do? That’s bound to happen
from time to time.

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>You can just take it easy and spend this time doing
whatever you like!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>This place has already changed so much, it’s barely
recognizable with so many more Pokémon here!
<$voicel(1,5)>You might want to consider exploring other places beyond
the area gate.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,664)>You might meet other Pokémon you can’t find around here!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,3)>Of course there’s nothing wrong with continuing to
improve THIS area! <$voicel(1,6)>I’m sure the Pokémon here would
be thrilled.
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>You’re free to do as you please! Go ahead and try plenty
of different things!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Well, there was that odd building on the beach...
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>You remember, don’t you? On the beach near the cave
where you and I first met.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>I’m sure that was made by humans. <$voicel(1,7)>But it seemed a bit
different from most ordinary buildings.

<$voicel(1,6)>If we investigate that building on the beach...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d wager there’s a chance we could find a clue about what
happened to the humans!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm... At this point, <$voicel(1,4)>I don’t think there’s much more
advice I can give you.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Thanks to all your hard work, Pokémon have returned, and
all the towns look so nice you’d hardly recognize them.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,1)>You could keep improving the environment for the
Pokémon here...
<$voicel(1,5)>Or make habitats so more new Pokémon can join us...
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,652)><$comeff(1,1)>Honestly, I think you’re best off just doing whatever you
feel like!

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,666)>I’ll admit I was shocked when that building on the beach
flew off.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)>But as I watched it go, I got the feeling that humans are
coming back someday. <$voicel(1,6)>So we can just take it easy and
wait for their return!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)>It seems that once there’s a place they’d like to live—that
is to say, a habitat—<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)>Pokémon will come back here!<$motion(1,652)>

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>There may be times when it takes quite a while for
Pokémon to show up after you finish making a habitat.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$comcan(1)><$facial(1,14)>But patience is often rewarded, you know! <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Some Pokémon
are rather shy, that’s all.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>Of course, different Pokémon probably all prefer different
environments. That’s the sticking point.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$kfacial(1)>If only there were hints about habitats just lying
around somewhere...

Sometimes when you’re out exploring, you may find
something sparkling—those are traces of a Pokémon!
If you touch one, you can get a hint about a habitat for a
Pokémon you haven’t yet befriended.
You can check the hints you’ve gathered at any time in
your <$cdef(27)>Pokédex!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Well, first of all, I’d suggest looking around near
their home.

<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,13)><$facial(1,9)>If they’re not home, they could be out and about
somewhere.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,654)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>Try asking other Pokémon where to find them!

If you’re having trouble finding a Pokémon, open your
Pokédex to that Pokémon’s page and select <$cdef(27)>Search!
If you talk to another Pokémon while you’re searching,
they might tell you where your friend is!
Some of them might even take you directly to the
Pokémon you’re searching for!

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,48)>If you STILL can’t find them, then I recommend using
some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3994)> near their home.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)>That sweet, irresistible scent will draw them back—just
you watch and see!

<$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Comfort level, eh? It might be a good idea to <$cdef(27)>talk to
various Pokémon.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comcan(1)><$motion(1,654)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>Then you could <$cdef(27)>put something you think those Pokémon
would like near their homes. <$voicel(1,6)>Why don’t you try that?

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>They’re sure to be pleased—that ought to improve
their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>The sticks and rocks lying around could be good
item-making materials.
<$voicel(1,5)>If you use your moves on logs and vines and such, I’d wager
you’ll get something useful from them too.<$motion(1,652)>

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>You might find different materials if you explore a bit
farther away.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comcan(1)><$motion(1,654)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, and I’ve heard that Pokémon called <$cdef(27)>Drifloon have some
sort of special power...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>And if you manage to befriend them, they’ll take you
to a land no one’s ever laid eyes on.

<$voicel(1,7)>You’ll most likely also find some Pokémon who’d be happy
to take the things you’ve gathered <$voicel(1,6)>and turn them into
useful materials!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>The more Pokémon you meet, the more different items
you’ll be able to make!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Remember—as you improve the environment around here,
you can get items from the <$cdef(27)>PC!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Humans really did have a great deal of convenient items!
<$voicel(1,7)>I think you ought to stop by the <$cdef(27)>PC every now and then to
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>check and see if you can get anything useful.

<$voicel(1,7)>Also, so long as you’ve got the <$cdef(27)>recipes and the right
<$cdef(27)>materials, <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,38)>I’m sure you can make more items yourself!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, and one more thing! If you search underground...
<$voicel(1,5)>you might find a lost relic left behind by humans.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,668)>If you do, just show it to me, and I’ll <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(25)> it and
tell you what you’ve found!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Even Pokémon can build houses if we’ve got <$cdef(27)>building kits</color>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,4)>Place one wherever you like, and then once you’ve
collected the necessary materials and gathered some
Pokémon to help out, <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing can begin!<$motion(1,652)>
You can purchase <$cdef(27)>building kits</color> at the <$cdef(27)>PC shop</color>.

Even if something is sold out, the store may restock it
at a later date, so keep checking regularly!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>Using your moves over and over can really tire you
out—eventually it’ll be hard to use any move at all!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>If you find yourself feeling worn to a frazzle like that,
try to find a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> or some other food, because
<$voicel(1,6)>that’s a good sign you need to eat!<$motion(1,652)>

Just as <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth says, eating berries is the most
basic way to restore <$cdef(27)>PP.
But you can also use an item called a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3976)> to raise
your maximum <$cdef(27)>PP!

You can buy <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3976)> at the <$cdef(27)>shop once you’ve raised the
environment level enough!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>When I think of all the Pokémon who might return here

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>But of course, I can’t let you young’uns show me up, so I

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>If there’s ever something you don’t understand, please

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! What are you getting up

<$voicel(1,5)>Remember—slow and steady! What’s important is to just

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>And if there’s ever anything you don’t understand, please

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Oho! This is a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center</color>! No doubt about it!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,826)>This place was bustling with humans and Pokémon in
the past.

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,1)>Maybe that’s why just having this building here makes me
feel more at ease.

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>You know, now that I stop and take a good look at it, this
whole area has changed quite a lot <$voicel(1,8)>since I met you.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,800)>Each of the Pokémon here must have been living on their
own before...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,22)><$comeff(1,9)>But now they seem to love being here. <$voicel(1,10)>We’ve got you to
thank for that.

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,18)>If the humans were to come back too, I couldn’t wish for
anything more...
<$voicel(1,4)>We must still be missing something...

<$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,824)>Ah well. No rush, I suppose.
<$voicel(1,9)>With you around, I’m sure we’ll see humans
again someday.

<$voicel(1,7)>There must have been many other places besides here
where humans all lived together.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,23)>It could be interesting to look for them!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho! The <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center</color>’s fixed, is it?

<$voicel(1,5)>I’m guessing this <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center will really come in
handy for you from now on.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Of course, it would be wonderful if the humans came
back too...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>But all that aside, this place is starting to look more like it
used to, all thanks to you.
<$voicel(1,6)>Let’s keep it up, <$cdef(27)>!

to

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>This town’s become quite lively thanks to you, hasn’t it?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>I believe everyone’s enjoying their lives here, but...well,
this place really was a wasteland before, you know.
<$voicel(1,7)>So there may be some Pokémon who aren’t really satisfied
with their environment.
<$voicel(1,5)>I’d really like to raise everyone’s <$cdef(27)>comfort levels, but I think
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>running all over the place to ask everyone what they need
may be a bit beyond me.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Do you have any bright ideas?

It sounds like raising the<$cdef(27)> environment level will help put
<$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth’s mind at ease!
The<$cdef(27)> environment level increases as more Pokémon arrive
and as their individual<$cdef(27)> comfort levels increase.

Report to <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth once you’ve raised the
<$cdef(27)>environment level to <$cdef(27)>five!
You can check the current <$cdef(27)>environment level at any time
at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center PC!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, you look like you’ve had
a brainwave!
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>In that case, I’ll leave the method up to you, but would
you please raise <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>the <$cdef(27)>comfort levels of this town’s Pokémon
even further?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>I know you’re the one for the job!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! I have a favor to ask.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>There are a great deal more Pokémon in this town now
thanks to you, wouldn’t you say?
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,3)>But I suspect among them, there may be some who aren’t
quite satisfied with their environment.
<$voicel(1,6)>Pokémon have such varied tastes, after all.

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>I know I’ve asked this of you before, but I’m asking here in
this town, too—<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)>would you please raise the <$cdef(27)>comfort levels

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I’ll leave the method up to you. I look forward to

to satisfy <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth!

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>I’ve got a piece of advice for you.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Do you remember how dried-up and empty this town was
before you came?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>There’s much more moisture now, and I believe many
Pokémon are very pleased about that.

<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>But some Pokémon do prefer drier environments.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Those Pokémon would probably prefer to live a bit of a
ways away from plants and water.
<$voicel(1,8)>I think it would be kind to move their homes.

<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>On the other hand, some Pokémon probably prefer even
more humidity!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d advise making homes for those Pokémon near water,
trees, and other plants.

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>I’ve got a piece of advice for you.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Thanks to all you and <$cdef(27)>Peakychu’s<$cdef(27)> hard work, this town has
really brightened up.
<$voicel(1,7)>But that brightness also affects Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>comfort levels.

<$voicel(1,5)>Pokémon who like especially bright places would probably
be pleased if <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>you set their homes near <$cdef(27)>streetlights or
the like.

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Meanwhile, you could build roofs on the homes of
Pokémon who prefer dark places <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>or move their homes
inside caves and such to improve their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>And given your track record, I’m sure you could even dig
into the ground <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>and make caves yourself!

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>I’ve got a piece of advice for you.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>I’m sure you’ll agree that <$cdef(27)>Chef Dente has really helped us
out in this town.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>The power of cooked food is certainly nothing to
